subject: Stale deal triage: verify stage, next step, and handover by EOD
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Stale deal triage: verify stage, next step, and handover by EOD

Team —

Running a quick hygiene pass on the August forecast. I pulled a list of 18 opportunities flagged as "no activity >60 days" or with last-contact unclear. Before finance locks the books on Monday, we need to confirm for each whether it should remain in the funnel, be reclassified, or be handed over to CS/procurements for follow-up.

Specifically for owners: please reply with one-line status for your deals (Stage / Next step / Confirmed close date or N/A). If you think the deal should move to "At Risk" or be archived, state it explicitly and include a short justification.

Key asks:
- Reply by EOD today (Friday) with the one-line status.
- If owner changes, add the new owner in your reply and update the HubSpot record.
- Attach any one-off docs (SOW, purchase order, scope) to the reply.

I attached a snapshot with the flagged rows (pipeline_trim_aug2027.xlsx). Finance (Evelyn) is on copy to tag anything that impacts the week-34 commit.

Thanks — I'll consolidate and publish an action list after responses.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pipeline_trim_aug2027.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stale deal triage: verify stage, next step, and handover by EOD

Karthik —

Thanks for the ping. Quick statuses for the ones on my list:
- ACME-472 (Prod Eval): Stage = Proposal; Next step = Final pricing call w/ Luke (scheduled 8/18); Close date = 2027-08-31 (tentative). Recommend keep in funnel and flag as "Deal at Risk" unless pricing call confirms. Attachment: acme_scope_notes.pdf.
- Nimbus-210 (Pilot): Stage = Contracting; Next step = Legal redlines; Close date = 2027-09-07. Keep live; legal is slow but active.
- Helix-98: Stage = Discovery; Next step = Email follow-up (no response 45 days); Close date = N/A. Recommend archive unless owner re-engages — I can take a one-week last-touch if you want.

I'll update HubSpot for ACME and Nimbus as discussed. Adding Jonas for any overlap on Helix.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_scope_notes.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T11:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stale deal triage: verify stage, next step, and handover by EOD

Quick note on ACME-472 and Helix-98:
- ACME-472: I agree with Marissa. I spoke with Luke two weeks ago and they are price-sensitive; I recommend a 2-week commercial concession window if we want to keep this in the commit. Request: can Finance confirm whether a small one-time credit would still allow us to hit margin thresholds? Evelyn?
- Helix-98: I don't own this but I can do the one-week last-touch if Marissa prefers to archive afterward.

If we can't get closure from ACME by 8/18 call, recommend moving to "Late-stage - Needs Exec Attention" and routing to Solutions Eng for a technical fast-track.

Jonas

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Stale deal triage: verify stage, next step, and handover by EOD

Karthik/Team —

Thanks for the quick updates. Finance note on concessions: we can approve a capped one-time credit for ACME-472 up to $15k without escalating to leadership, provided margins remain >= 18% post-credit and legal signs the amendment before 8/25. I'll mark ACME-472 as "Conditional Commit" in the forecast once the pricing call is complete and Marissa updates the HubSpot deal with final terms.

I'll also pull a marginality check for all flagged deals and share any that would push us below threshold.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference
